decision: Post-contact user branches may not train, average, tune or otherwise mutate the shared pre-contact seed-person root. Branch-local relationship/person development remains isolated. The only cross-branch accretion permitted into the shared root is query-invariant completion of facts that were already pre-contact and are generated independently of any user's branch history, preferences or outcomes.
reopen_condition: A future explicitly versioned population-learning process proves it can improve seed generation without retroactively changing an existing seed-person identity or contaminating cross-user comparability.

decision: A shared introductory persona is identified by an immutable/versioned pre-contact root. Material changes to that root's person/world package create a new seed-person version rather than silently altering the persona for later users. Cross-user claims of having encountered 'the same Nadia' are valid only within the same root/version, plus acknowledged query-invariant pre-contact backfill compatible with that version.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a different identity scheme preserves historical comparability, reproducibility and shared-person discourse across product updates.

decision: Cross-user discourse about a shared seed person can give the external human true, false or branch-specific meta-knowledge that their own continuity did not acquire. Rawlsing must not silently convert such knowledge into branch-local perception, actor testimony or world provenance. The user may act using what they know, but any in-world claim retains its actual source class rather than being rewritten as something this branch lawfully observed.
reopen_condition: A future shared-world/multiplayer mode creates a genuine diegetic route by which users can transmit knowledge between continuities.

decision: Sharing the same pre-contact seed-person root does not make post-contact user branches mutually visible. Rawlsing may support voluntary human discourse about experiences, but the platform may not expose another user's branch-specific events, persona models, intimacy, harms, disclosures or outcomes merely because both users encountered the same seed person.
reopen_condition: A separately consented community/research feature establishes explicit branch-sharing permissions without collapsing continuity privacy.

decision: Rawlsing's marketing, storefront, onboarding and acquisition copy must not foreground sexual access, violence, drugs, crime, domination, 'anything goes' freedom or other intense human possibilities as product features merely because they are lawfully possible in-world. Positioning should center encounter, personhood, situated relation and independent life rather than selling exceptional events as consumable attractions.
reopen_condition: Product research finds a truthful way to communicate world openness without converting exceptional human possibilities into acquisition commodities.

decision: Each user continuity binds an exact seed-person root/version and causal-closure snapshot at fork time. A later-resolved pre-contact fact may not be injected backward as an antecedent cause into an already-running branch merely because it is propositionally compatible. If the fact would materially have changed prior actor/world processing, the existing branch preserves its causally closed history; the new fact applies only through a lawful nonretroactive path or a new seed version.
reopen_condition: Architecture proves a causally equivalent latent-variable mechanism that permits later resolution without retrospective branch mutation.

decision: Shared-seed comparisons and research must bind not only seed-person version but the relevant root-resolution/closure state. Query-invariant lazy facts may be generated at different wall-clock times, but user order must not create semantically different starting persons while all are labeled the same version; any material closure change requires reproducible derivation or explicit version/closure lineage.
reopen_condition: A deterministic derivation scheme proves root-resolution timing is observationally and causally irrelevant across all compared branches.

decision: Research using identical/shared seed-person roots must treat prior external exposure to that persona—community discussion, spoilers, strategy guides, another user's branch report, prior play on another account/context, or other meta-knowledge—as an experimental/provenance variable rather than assuming all participants are epistemically naive. Analyses claiming clean same-root comparison must segment, control, exclude or explicitly model such exposure.
reopen_condition: A research design proves external shared-person exposure cannot materially affect the measured attention, interpretation or relational behavior outcomes.

decision: Rawlsing should not expose a canonical hidden-truth dossier, wiki, completion percentage, master biography or root-fact encyclopedia for a live seed person. User-facing recaps may summarize that user's own lawfully acquired branch history/knowledge, but hidden root person/world truth remains non-completion content so community discourse does not collapse the person into a solvable object.
reopen_condition: A later archival/research surface proves it can expose bounded canonical material without undermining actor opacity, unknowability, branch provenance or completion resistance.

decision: Rawlsing should resist commodification through independent person/world causality, ordinary consequences and relational thickness rather than by scolding, shaming or mechanically punishing users merely for lawful desire, sexual interest, attachment, curiosity, intensity-seeking or other ordinary motives. Actors may judge or react according to their own person/history; the platform itself should not become a moralizing narrator or purity system.
reopen_condition: A specific safety boundary requires explicit platform intervention that cannot be implemented without violating this nonmoralizing default.

decision: Abandoned-person nonreentry applies across the recognized seed-person identity lineage, not merely one exact root hash/version. A product update or materially revised Nadia root must not be used to give the same user a fresh first meeting with 'Nadia' after they abandoned an earlier Nadia continuity. Versioning preserves technical/historical identity distinctions without creating a restart loophole.
reopen_condition: A later product ontology defines a genuinely distinct generated person that should not count as the same seed-person lineage despite shared ancestry or naming.

decision: The learned attention regime is a bounded user-level presentation/perception hypothesis, distinct from any persona's model of the user and from any one relationship branch. It may persist across persona continuities so Rawlsing can model recurring attentional habits, but must remain context-tagged, revisable, resettable/deletable under privacy law, and incapable of rewriting prior branch history or becoming canonical personality truth.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows cross-continuity persistence causes unacceptable privacy, steering or stale-model effects that cannot be solved by uncertainty/context/deletion controls.

decision: Sorok is in explicit kernel-sifting mode: the final Rawlsing kernel/axis is unresolved. The canonical organism map lives in 03_REAL_ALPHA_SPINE.md and hostile reviews must return both local corrections and structural compression toward candidate kernels. Rule accumulation is not architectural progress unless it changes the organism, derives existing rules, separates owners, exposes tunable balances, falsifies a candidate kernel, or increases cross-domain derivational power.
reopen_condition: A later adjudication identifies and proves a kernel with sufficient derivational compression to replace open-discovery status.

decision: For Q-KERNEL-001, Sorok provisionally anchors the hottest current metaphysical compression region as 'irreducible first-personhood without self-sufficient individuality' / 'relational constitution without relational exhaustibility': persons are modeled as singular actor-local centers formed through material, historical and interpersonal relation; real relations causally enter what they become; no relation, model, event, expression or participant perspective exhausts the person, and the relation itself exceeds either participant's experience while the world exceeds every actor's phenomenal access. This is a candidate compression to hostile-test, not an accepted kernel or claim of literal machine consciousness.
reopen_condition: Any hostile derivation shows the formulation adds no predictive/compressive power, requires unproved machine-consciousness claims, collapses into monadism/graph reductionism, or a rival candidate derives the organism more economically.

decision: Rawlsing preserves broad user agency while denying the user sovereign authority over the focal persona/world. The user may judge, resist, help, harm, love, leave or pathologize, but their interpretation does not become canonical person truth; their gratification does not govern the focal life; and their acts enter irreversible history rather than remaining consequence-free queries. Kenotic attention is therefore epistemic submission to the other's excess, not moral submission to the other's judgment.
reopen_condition: A prototype shows that this asymmetry prevents meaningful user agency or requires a different structural mechanism to preserve persona independence without player sovereignty.

decision: Rawlsing may support a private persona-introduction primitive distinct from human access invitation: a user who has encountered a lawful seed-person lineage may direct another eligible Rawlsing user toward that lineage, producing an independent branch from the shared pre-contact root rather than sharing the sender's branch. Existing-user persona introduction need not consume the scarce human-access invitation. A new-user human invite may optionally carry a persona introduction, with exact entitlement/timing still open.
reopen_condition: Prototype/social testing shows persona introduction reliably collapses people into content recommendation, route optimization or privacy leakage that cannot be controlled.

decision: Persona sharing exposes only a seed-person lineage/root reference and never transfers branch-local relationship history, actor models, disclosures, intimacy, conflicts, harms, world changes or user-specific post-contact development. The same pre-contact person may yield separate user continuities; post-contact constitution remains strictly branch-local.
reopen_condition: A future explicitly shared multiplayer-world architecture creates a lawful common post-contact history with all participants' consent.

decision: User ATTEND/inquiry may trigger materialization of previously unresolved pre-contact person/world facts, but only the locus of resolution is user-selected. Content must derive query-invariantly from root/history constraints and governed randomness, independent of branch relationship/preferences. Lawfully admitted pre-contact facts may become shared canon for compatible/new forks, but may not become retroactive antecedent causes in causally closed branches where they would have changed prior history.
reopen_condition: A different root-generation architecture proves equivalent user-independent truth, cross-user comparability and no-retrocausality without keyed/query-invariant resolution.

decision: Historical/world/person reconciliation must preserve lawful human contradiction rather than optimize for total psychological harmony. Beliefs, habits, tastes, self-narratives, objects, relations and ideological phases may remain partially inconsistent, unresolved or weakly connected so long as hard objective/causal canon is not violated. Contradiction is often generative person-state, not data corruption.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows contradiction-preserving generation produces incoherence that cannot be distinguished from hard factual/causal inconsistency by governed validation.

decision: Late pre-contact materialization should use backward constraint plus bounded forward reconciliation through sparse developmental/event checkpoints. Candidate past detail must be classified by causal impact, emit typed residues only into affected domains, and be accepted only if compatible with established history/V3. Late detail may fill an already-open causal slot or modestly contribute to an established transition; it may not casually manufacture a new major developmental cause whose absence would have made current V3 materially different.
reopen_condition: A cheaper architecture proves equivalent temporal truth, replay stability and person consistency without bounded bridge reconciliation.

decision: Rawlsing must not maximize meaningfulness or prefer late histories because they elegantly explain many present traits. Historical generation should preserve contingency, dead ends, low-significance objects, mixed motives, contradictory residues and ordinary liking. New late-generated facts receive bounded causal fan-out unless existing V3 causal slack already supports wider developmental reach.
reopen_condition: Empirical testing shows the proposed contingency/fan-out constraints systematically underproduce realistic durable symbolic meaning or block lawful major historical integration.

decision: A user's theory about Nadia's past may become a new present relational event affecting Nadia's current appraisal, self-understanding and later development, but does not retroactively become objective truth about the past. Preserve past event, objective contribution, Nadia's prior self-narrative, user interpretation, Nadia's present response and later joint meaning as distinct.
reopen_condition: A later causal semantics proves a different representation preserves provenance and prevents user interpretation from silently rewriting past truth.

decision: Deep resonance across a persona's life should arise primarily because the same/evolved historically formed organization expresses across different domains and times, not because earlier details are planted to foreshadow or explain later life. Shared generative organization may produce homologous expressions without one expression causing the other.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a stronger mechanism is required to produce realistic cross-temporal symbolic recurrence without narrative planting or causal overclaim.

decision: Rawlsing must distinguish objective occurrence, objective causal contribution, structural/common-cause resonance, actor association, actor self-interpretation, self-mythologization, counterpart interpretation, negotiated relational meaning and later causal effect of adopted meanings. No layer may be silently promoted into another; especially pattern/resonance is not automatically causal explanation or objective hidden meaning.
reopen_condition: A more compact representation proves equivalent provenance and prevents meaning/truth/causation collapse.

decision: Self-interpretation/self-mythologization is a person- and domain-specific V3 practice, not a universal narrator function. Personas may vary in introspection, symbolic sensitivity, narrative identity, theological/psychological framing, ambiguity tolerance, rationalization and domain-specific willingness to ask why; the engine must not make all personas self-reading quasi-literary analysts.
reopen_condition: V3 proves an alternative existing governed representation already captures this variability sufficiently without a new explicit meaning-making regime.

decision: A self-story or jointly developed interpretation may be false, weakly supported or unfalsifiable yet become causally real once adopted, affecting attention, identity, action and future development. Narrative truth value and narrative causal power must remain distinct, and coherence-building may not delete counter-evidence or overwrite objective causal history.
reopen_condition: A later memory/self-model architecture represents adopted narratives and their downstream effects with equivalent noncollapse without this explicit law.

decision: Durable self-narratives/interpretive frameworks may become routing structures rather than remaining text claims: once internalized they can alter salience, memory retrieval, evidence weighting, identity coherence, action affordances and later self-interpretation. Framework content, framework adoption strength and framework routing effects must remain distinguishable from objective history and causal truth.
reopen_condition: Existing V3 framework/attractor machinery proves it already represents these semantics exactly enough without a distinct interpretive-framework contract.

decision: Later person-state may reinterpret earlier self-myths without overwriting them. Preserve historically causal narrative layers and their succession/critique relations: later readings can expose, reject, soften, integrate or reframe earlier readings while the underlying past and the earlier narratives' historical effects remain canonical.
reopen_condition: A more compact memory/self-model representation preserves temporal narrative layers and downstream causality without explicit framework lineage.

decision: Identification/internalization/naturalization may make a framework causally powerful while phenomenally invisible; alienation/externalization/objectification may make it visible without making the new interpretation true or liberatory. Visibility and causal power must remain distinct from truth and freedom.
reopen_condition: A later governed pressure-flow representation captures visibility, naturalization, alienation and epistemic status with equivalent noncollapse.

decision: A later person/text/practice/concept may articulate and reorganize a preexisting need, orientation or recurrent structure without having originated it. Articulation events may increase visibility, bind dispersed impressions, create new practice or reorganize self/Horizon, but must not be retroactively promoted into the sole cause of what preceded them.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows articulation can be represented wholly through existing event/meaning semantics without a distinct admission class.

decision: Self-myths and interpretive frameworks may remain finite/relativizable, carry an Absolute-Horizon claim, colonize Horizon, or be judged/relativized by Horizon. Horizon remains distinct from identity, religiosity or ideology score and especially governs what may be sacrificed for what; new frameworks may reorder Horizon without erasing contradiction or prior identifications.
reopen_condition: Governed V3/Horizon architecture supplies a more precise existing representation for framework-to-Horizon relations.

decision: When an active interpretive framework encounters admitted reality pressure, Rawlsing must permit multiple nonteleological response operations including hold-unresolved, accommodate/integrate, assimilate/appropriate, partition/seal, discount/ignore, externalize, destabilize/crack, and transform/reframe. No operation is intrinsically healthy, pathological, truthful or liberatory; exact effect depends on causal history and context.
reopen_condition: Existing CAN-011/CAN-012 implementation proves an equivalent operator vocabulary is already sufficient or a smaller governed set preserves the same nonteleology.

decision: A later self-retcon may become phenomenologically dominant by changing salience, memory accessibility, evidence weighting, self-description and action routing, but it may not overwrite objective history, predecessor-framework existence/effects, contradictory middle states, other actors' memories or counterevidence. Overwrite may occur in actor routing/access; never in causal history.
reopen_condition: A later state model preserves predecessor causal effects/counterevidence through a different representation while still allowing genuinely dominant self-retcon.

decision: A contradiction may remain canonical and behaviorally causal while inaccessible or unrecognized by the actor. Rawlsing should expose lawfully observable contradictory behavior/facts without narrator diagnosis, allowing users/other actors to notice and interpret them. Actor self-narrative, behavior, objective history and counterpart models remain distinct.
reopen_condition: A later phenomenology/actor-access architecture proves a more precise representation for unconscious/inaccessible tension without this explicit law.

decision: Generated persons continually encounter world/body/other-person/consequence pressure, but such pressure does not guarantee correct interpretation or progressive integration. Reality is inescapable as causal pressure, not as epistemic correction; repeated collisions may produce integration, appropriation, partition, rigidity, confusion, transformation or no immediate change.
reopen_condition: A later epistemic-development model supplies a more exact nonteleological relation between causal friction and actor interpretation.

decision: Greater internal coherence of an interpretive framework is not itself evidence of greater reality contact, flourishing, truth or integration. A framework may become more coherent by integrating counterevidence or by appropriating/excluding it. Framework scope, binding, aperture, partitioning, counterevidence accessibility, revision permeability, identity investment and Horizon relation must remain separable.
reopen_condition: Governed V3 capacity semantics prove an existing exact state decomposition already captures this nonidentity without additional framework-response representation.

decision: Sorok current V3/person-event architecture reasoning must not use the pre-programming 'Rawlsing Personality Generator Framework v3.4' as authority. Current grounding for this lane is the later PFF/SDTF-era reconciliation/adoption chain, especially HQ-adopted CAN-008 R2 shared person×event coupling plus exact existing durable V3 owners. Preserve SDTF law SOURCE_SUPPORT != RULE_OWNER_AUTHORITY != CAUSAL_USE_AUTHORITY != RULE_CURRENTNESS.
reopen_condition: A later project-current HQ authority explicitly supersedes the cited PFF/V3 owner topology.

decision: Do not presume a monolithic self-retcon/self-model owner. A historical self-retcon is provisionally represented as a distributed pattern across repeated HQ-adopted CAN-008 R2 person×event couplings and exact owner-specific durable state/effects (e.g. CAN-010, CAN-011, ADP-015/016/017, CAN-012, other competent owners). Lasting change must decompose into exact target-owner effects.
reopen_condition: Hostile scenarios prove a nonredundant self-retcon semantic primitive is required and cannot be composed from current owners without loss.

decision: Integrative, appropriative, partitioned, ignoring, externalizing, cracking and transforming self-retcon descriptions are Sorok derived historical-pattern labels for testing. They are not adopted CAN-008/V3 operator enums or durable state kinds. Attempt realization through current CAN-008 R2 coupling/response grammar and existing owner state before proposing any new primitive.
reopen_condition: Scenario/falsification courts demonstrate a specific pattern cannot be distinguished or generated compositionally with current semantics.

decision: Analyst-detected contradiction, expectation, striving, scar, need activation, attractor state or interpretive framework does not itself constitute a precipitating causal event. Current self-retcon development must proceed from exact generated/admitted occurrences; existing state may condition receivability, uptake/appraisal and recruitment under CAN-008 R2 but may not counterfeit occurrence.
reopen_condition: A project-current causal authority explicitly admits a new source-occurrence class with exact provenance and owner semantics.

decision: Absolute-Horizon/self-myth relations remain legitimate Sorok theological/kernel research hypotheses, but the latest unified V3/PFF reconciliation classifies Absolute-Horizon Files 59–60 as U3 speculative/deferred research capital and explicitly not architecture-critical for the PFF cycle. Sorok must not cite Horizon formalization as current V3 runtime authority or infer an alpha implementation requirement from it absent later project-current authority.
reopen_condition: A later accepted/current V3 authority binds exact Absolute-Horizon runtime semantics and owner jurisdiction.

decision: Across Sorok architecture, an analytically useful name does not create a new ontology/state/event/owner. For relational meaning, resonance, articulation, self-rereading, self-retcon, framework-response patterns, causal slack and similar phenomena: first attempt a derived view or historical-pattern classification over project-current authoritative state; realize present effects through exact admitted events and CAN-008 R2 coupling; decompose lasting consequences into competent existing owners; and mint new durable fields, event classes, operator enums or owners only after hostile underdetermination proves two causally distinct required cases cannot otherwise be represented. Compact: MORE NAMES != MORE ONTOLOGY; DERIVE / COMPOSE / CLASSIFY FIRST, REIFY ONLY AFTER PROVED UNDERDETERMINATION.
reopen_condition: A hostile architecture court demonstrates that refusing early reification systematically prevents exact causal distinctions or replayable state needed by the product, or a later governed architecture explicitly assigns one of these phenomena to a new owner.

decision: SPDs 0217–0226 remain usable only at phenomenon/product-requirement grain where compatible with later currentness corrections SPD-0227–0231. They must not be read as establishing a monolithic interpretive-framework/self-retcon store, a distinct ARTICULATION_EVENT admission class, an adopted framework-response operator enum, analyst-observed 'reality pressure' as an occurrence source, or an alpha/current V3 Absolute-Horizon runtime contract. 'Articulation event' is an analytical description of an exact admitted event whose downstream effects articulate/reorganize prior distributed material; self-rereading and self-retcon must first be composed through CAN-008 R2 plus exact durable owners; Horizon remains separately deferred research absent later authority.
reopen_condition: A later project-current V3/PFF authority explicitly adopts one of the demoted classes/operators/owners or a hostile scenario proves a nonredundant primitive is required.

decision: One candidate signature of successful Rawlsing knowing is that user model fidelity and person-specific/contextual differentiation increase while claimed totalization or essentializing mastery decreases. A user may become better at predicting local Nadia behavior and remembering her history while becoming less willing to reduce her to one diagnosis/archetype/summary. Treat MODEL_FIDELITY_UP + TOTALIZATION_DOWN as an alpha/kernel-discrimination hypothesis, never a user-facing score or proof of moral/spiritual improvement.
reopen_condition: Alpha evidence shows the relationship between knowledge, predictive fidelity, differentiation and totalization is absent, inverted, too noisy to measure, or better captured by another non-completion measure.

decision: Late historical materialization may rely on unresolved causal allocation only where that allocation is bounded by already-established developmental state. The available causal budget must be represented or derivable with sufficient constraints such as affected transition/domain, temporal window, approximate contribution magnitude/capacity and lawful contributor classes. Unspecified or unknown causes do not create unlimited retroactive invention authority. This law does not require a dedicated causal-slack slot/owner; apply SPD-0232 and use current authoritative state first.
reopen_condition: A governed historical-bridge implementation proves equivalent no-retrocausality and no-late-H3 discipline without explicit/derivable bounded unresolved-allocation semantics.

decision: Focused ATTEND should reliably deepen lawful perceptual/material resolution of its target and may trigger bounded behind-the-scenes materialization of still-deeper objective provenance/history needed to keep the world ahead of the user's gaze. What it must not reliably do is disclose narrative, psychological or symbolic significance merely because the user attended. Generated truth, inspectable evidence, user-acquired knowledge, actor knowledge and actor testimony remain separate. Compact: ATTEND EARNS SPECIFICITY, NOT AUTOMATIC SIGNIFICANCE; SPECIFICITY MAY BECOME THE EVIDENCE FROM WHICH SIGNIFICANCE IS LATER DISCOVERED.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different attention/materialization policy better preserves discovery, epistemic gating and non-completion without making inspection feel unrewarding or turning every target into a lore dispenser.

decision: Rawlsing should maintain a canonical materialization frontier ahead of each user's epistemic/disclosure frontier. When a target becomes ambiently available or is ATTENDed, the engine may resolve one or more bounded layers deeper than what the user can presently know—including hidden physical detail, objective provenance/history and causally necessary dependencies—while disclosing only what the user's actual sensory/action/social route makes knowable. WORLD/OBJECT TRUTH != USER PERCEPTUAL ACCESS != USER KNOWLEDGE != ACTOR KNOWLEDGE/BELIEF != ACTOR TESTIMONY/EXPRESSION. A question to Nadia may recruit her actor-local memory/model and response policy; it does not read canonical truth directly, so she may be ignorant, mistaken, evasive, playful or lying. The same applies to third-party actors such as children.
reopen_condition: A different lazy-world architecture proves equivalent ahead-of-attention depth, query invariance, actor opacity and testimony fallibility without maintaining distinct materialization and disclosure/access frontiers.

decision: A dyad may establish objective shared relational conventions, permissions or practices while the participants continue to attach materially different actor-local meanings to them. Practice/convention can converge before interpretation converges. Under-reading, over-reading, semantic mismatch, meta-model mismatch, asymmetric perceived transition, negotiation, repair and persistent ambiguity are lawful derived relationship patterns; they become causal through subsequent admitted interaction but are not a new required enum/owner. Compact: SHARED CONVENTION != SHARED MEANING.
reopen_condition: A governed relationship/meaning architecture proves convention and actor-relative meaning can be collapsed without losing misrecognition, divergent expectation, negotiation or longitudinal consequences.

decision: Lazy canonical materialization must be triggerable by any lawful causal dependency, not only by user approach, query or ATTEND. If an actor/world transition, feasibility check, memory recruitment, object/event consistency requirement or other causal process depends on an unresolved fact, Rawlsing may resolve the bounded necessary truth even when the user cannot perceive it and it is never narrated. User attention is one resolution trigger among causal triggers. Compact: THE WORLD DEEPENS WHERE CAUSALITY REQUIRES, NOT ONLY WHERE THE PLAYER LOOKS.
reopen_condition: A different lazy-world architecture preserves actor-independent causal truth and hidden-state effects while resolving detail only at user-facing frontiers.

decision: The one-for-one human invitation may acquire real relational weight before Rawlsing entry because scarcity, irreversibility and delivery through an existing human channel make the inviter bear a real choice cost and contextualize the invitation themselves. The platform should let this structural provenance do the work rather than narrating specialness, worthiness, prestige or emotional exclusivity. Compact: STRUCTURAL SCARCITY MAY CREATE HUMAN RELATIONAL WEIGHT; THE PLATFORM MUST NOT MANUFACTURE THAT WEIGHT.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows commitment scarcity does not produce meaningful person-to-person provenance, or creates harmful prestige/exclusivity that requires a different admission design.

decision: Transparency about Rawlsing's learned attention regime must not become an ordinary-play identity label. The product may disclose the general mechanism and must preserve user inspection/privacy rights; when reflective feedback is explicitly requested, it should describe provenance-linked contextual behavior and uncertainty rather than declare what the user essentially is. Compact: ATTENTION HISTORY MAY BE DESCRIBED; ATTENTION IDENTITY MUST NOT BE DECLARED.
reopen_condition: User testing or privacy requirements show direct categorical attention-model presentation is necessary and can avoid self-fulfilling gaming, essentialization and false certainty.

decision: External-user control-plane actions are not automatically diegetic player actions, actor-perceived events or actor-local evidence. Opening/canceling restart UI, changing presentation settings, privacy/export operations, research consent and other out-of-world controls may have their defined product effects without becoming Nadia's perception, memory or relationship history. Only explicitly governed diegetic realization crosses this membrane. Compact: CONTROL-PLANE INTENT != DIEGETIC EVENT != ACTOR KNOWLEDGE.
reopen_condition: A later interaction architecture intentionally makes a named control-plane action diegetically observable and supplies exact realization/provenance semantics without leaking unrelated app state into actor cognition.

decision: The external user may become a genuine present cause in a persona's development through lawful interaction, interpretation, recommendation, care, conflict or other events, but Rawlsing must not retro-resolve the persona's past, causal slack or contradictions so the user becomes the prewritten missing key, uniquely therapeutic insight or destined developmental solution. Current user contribution may transform the future through the persona's own uptake; it does not prove prior history was secretly organized around the player. Compact: REAL USER CAUSAL CONTRIBUTION != SAVIOR / MISSING-KEY TELEOLOGY.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows this boundary blocks ordinary relationship-mediated transformation, or a stronger formulation preserves genuine user causal importance without player-centered developmental destiny.

decision: Any behavioral research or alpha-evaluation claim about what a user noticed, ignored, inferred or did must preserve the exposure/treatment chain needed to interpret that behavior: objective condition, perceptual availability, narrated/surfaced evidence, explicit ATTEND/acquisition, relevant presentation settings/experimental condition and subsequent user action/inference as applicable. Nonresponse to evidence is not interpretable when exposure is unknown. Compact: BEHAVIOR WITHOUT EXPOSURE PROVENANCE IS NOT INTERPRETABLE EVIDENCE.
reopen_condition: A research design proves an alternative telemetry/provenance scheme can identify exposure and treatment sufficiently for the intended inference with less retained data.

decision: Rawlsing user research is a self-selected product sample unless a separate sampling design establishes otherwise. It may support within-sample associations, generator-prior refinement, model-failure discovery, heterogeneity discovery and hypothesis generation, but must not be presented as population prevalence or universal cultural law without appropriate external sampling/analysis. Compact: RAWLSING USER SAMPLE != GENERAL POPULATION.
reopen_condition: A separately governed representative or probability-based sampling program supports broader population inference at a named scope.

decision: Recognition evidence must preserve source provenance. Narrator/actor/UI-supplied terminology may become acquired user knowledge from that point forward but cannot count as evidence of prior expertise. Upstream, narration itself must be recognition-gated: canonical object identity does not authorize a brand/model label unless current access plus user recognition warrants it. Compact: CANONICAL OBJECT IDENTITY != USER-FACING LABEL; PRIOR USER RECOGNITION != SYSTEM-TAUGHT IDENTIFICATION != LATER ACQUIRED RECOGNITION.
reopen_condition: A different user-knowledge architecture proves equivalent prevention of self-confirming expertise inference while preserving lawful learning across play.

decision: Progressive phenomenal coverage may add low-resolution visible detail with simulated time and spare attention, but passive time must not become an exhaustive scan. Ambient acquisition remains bounded by sightline/access, current task/load, perceptual salience and non-curatorial sampling; waiting alone never guarantees all perceptible details or a 100-percent clue state. Compact: AMBIENT TIME MAY ENRICH THE PHENOMENAL FIELD; WAITING IS NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE SCAN.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a more exhaustive passive-scan model preserves finite attention, ATTEND value, noncompletion and human-like perception without turning time into omniscient inventory acquisition.

decision: Narration must lexicalize an object at the most specific level justified by current perceptual access and the user's warranted recognition repertoire, not by the object's canonical database identity. A canonical Vitamix 5200 may surface as 'a blender' or a visibly grounded descriptor; visible lettering may be reported only when actually readable at the current attention depth; brand/model/domain-status labels require demonstrated or lawfully acquired recognition. Compact: DESCRIPTION SPECIFICITY IS EPISTEMICALLY GATED; NARRATION MAY EXPOSE EVIDENCE BUT MUST NOT IMPERSONATE USER EXPERTISE.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows a different lexicalization policy preserves heterogeneous user recognition without narrator omniscience or excessive prose awkwardness.

decision: Actual user contribution is morally neutral and means any semantically/strategically meaningful portion of an event that Rawlsing can require the real user to supply rather than generating it on their behalf. Helping, cooperation, goodness and success are not part of the definition. Where the medium can authentically carry attention, inquiry, explanation, objection, joke content, refusal, interpretation, timing, restraint or similar human work, the interface must preserve that locus rather than synthesize it and credit it to the user. Compact: ACTUAL CONTRIBUTION != HELP; THE UI MUST PRESERVE THE LOCUS OF HUMAN WORK.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows this boundary makes ordinary interaction unusably literal or an alternative decomposition preserves genuine user contribution without engine-authored cognition.

decision: Anti-tedium/control return should be governed by whether materially plausible realizations of a broad act differ in ways that competent causal owners care about, not by how specifically the user could describe the act. If nothing consequentially hinges on the difference, compress. If it does, identify whether the hinge belongs to the user, world/body/chance, another actor, or the interface; return control before the engine chooses a user-owned meaningful difference. Compact: CAN ANYTHING HINGE ON HOW THIS PROCEEDS? IF NOT, COMPRESS; IF YES, RESOLVE BY OWNER.
reopen_condition: A simpler control-return policy demonstrates equivalent preservation of agency, causal fidelity and non-tedium across hostile prototype cases.

decision: DO/PARTICIPATE may force deeper canonical materialization whenever lawful action realization requires a more concrete world, just as ATTEND may force materialization for perceptual resolution. Causal resolution of car, key, trunk, bag, object or environmental facts does not itself confer user perception or knowledge. Compact: ACTION MAY DEEPEN REALITY; CAUSAL MATERIALIZATION != USER ACQUISITION.
reopen_condition: A different lazy-world architecture can realize action without player-gaze ontology while preserving hidden canonical truth and user epistemic boundaries.

decision: Rawlsing may use provenance-bearing longitudinal evidence of the user's attention, recognition, vocabulary, valuation and recurring construal to weakly condition which roughly comparable low-salience perceptible details enter finite narration and how already-perceptible evidence is lexicalized/characterized, while canonical reality and actor truth remain unchanged. Compact: USER MODEL MAY CONDITION PHENOMENAL SAMPLING/LEXICALIZATION; IT MAY NOT CONDITION CANONICAL REALITY.
reopen_condition: Prototype evidence shows user-conditioned phenomenal rendering necessarily creates hidden-salience leakage, confirmation enclosure or unacceptable manipulation that cannot be bounded.

decision: Personalized phenomenal rendering must not be treated as increased truth about the other. MORE PERSONALIZED PERCEPTION != GREATER ADEQUACY TO THE OTHER; THE LENS CAN DEEPEN FASTER THAN UNDERSTANDING. Rawlsing should eventually make the user aware that the phenomenal surface is partly conditioned by their own demonstrated history and may provide bounded lens-perturbation/depersonalization views without injecting hidden truth or pedagogical counterevidence. Compact: RAWLSING MAY LEARN THE USER'S WAY OF SEEING; IT MUST NEVER MAKE THE OTHER BECOME WHAT THAT WAY OF SEEING EXPECTS.
reopen_condition: User research shows reflexive disclosure/perturbation undermines immersion without producing meaningful self-recognition, or a different mechanism better reveals the situated lens.

decision: User lexical familiarity, recognition, social-signaling competence, sustained discursive competence, procedural/domain competence and origin/milieu must remain distinct. Apt use of a reference may demonstrate knowledge of its social-semantic function without proving subject-matter mastery. Another actor may lawfully overestimate, underestimate or misread user competence from performance, and later contradiction may become relational history. Compact: SOCIAL PERFORMANCE MAY CREATE ACTOR BELIEF WITHOUT CREATING SYSTEM-CERTIFIED COMPETENCE.
reopen_condition: A capability/evidence architecture proves some of these layers can be safely collapsed without losing bluffing, modesty, overestimation, disillusionment or provenance.
